title: The Morning Routine Story
goal: Reorder picture cards to build simple narrative sequence.
steps: Look at the scattered picture cards.
Drag or arrange them in the order they happened.
Retell the short story to your grown-up.
parent_tips: Use time words like 'first', 'then', and 'finally' during retell.

content.retell_prompt: Tell your grown-up what happened first, next, and last.

strengths_message: Brilliant storytelling! You put the events in the right order.
